overview: A CRM only helps if it is current, and that usually means someone typing. We build rules that create contacts from forms and emails, move deals when something happens, create follow-up tasks, assign owners and flag deals that have gone quiet. We work inside your own CRM account, document every rule, and test on a copy before anything touches live records.

faq: Which CRMs do you work with?
HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, Salesforce, Zendesk Sell, Airtable-based CRMs and others with an open connection. Tell us yours and we confirm before you order.
Will you change my existing records?
Not without your approval. We test rules on a copy or a few test records first, and we show you what each rule would do before it runs on live data.
Do you handle data privacy rules?
We build only what you request and keep to your CRM's rules. You remain responsible for having permission to store and contact people under privacy laws that apply to you.
What if my pipeline stages change?
Rules refer to your stages, so a rename or new stage means a small edit. We show you where to change them in the handover guide.
